cd /workspace/tmp && python3 - <<'PYEOF' 2>&1 | tail -30
import json, random, sys, tempfile
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
import fuzz as F
r2 = random.Random(1018)
cfg = F.gen_config(r2)
ops = F.gen_requests(r2, cfg)
print("CONFIG", json.dumps(cfg))
print("REQS", F.lines_of(ops))
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
    p, err = F.compile_prog(cfg, d)
    data = F.lines_of(ops).encode()
    rc1, o1, e1 = F.run_cmd([F.SUB, "stream", p], data)
    rc2, o2, e2 = F.run_cmd([F.REF, p], data)
    print("rc", rc1, rc2, e1[:300])
    a=o1.decode().splitlines(); b=o2.decode().splitlines()
    print(len(a), len(b))
    for i,(x,y) in enumerate(zip(a,b)):
        if x!=y:
            print("DIFF line", i)
            print(" req:", json.dumps(ops[i]))
            print(" sub:", x)
            print(" ref:", y)
            break
PYEOF
